purpose: Preserve renderer.info memory/program values from two identical-camera roof-detail runs after detecting that the diagnostic cache counters were not stable.
limitations: Console outputs were recorded as two runs; the first roof-detail-capture.json was overwritten by the repeat.
These renderer.info counters are not vertex/index counts, unique source geometry references, texture-byte residency, or GPU time.
The actual roof positions/indices, track-scene object traversal, full race-frame geometry and A/B submitted workload were separately checked and matched.
interpretation: No stable A/B difference in renderer cache/program counters was established. Do not infer a geometry or texture resource increase/saving from these counters.
